title: [r3] Declare per-module optimization directions and primary metrics (A626)
summary: Governor-directed addition: pins the per-module optimization matrix (direction + primary observation metrics) for C runtime, C++ inference, Rust vector engine, Go search, C#/F#, Julia, JAX and JavaScript/React, with a before/after evidence requirement and a fast-math guardrail.
origin: human-governor directive 2026-09-26 (module optimization matrix + '都做'); resubmitted under sovereign requester per ACTIVE_SOVEREIGN_REQUESTERS

problem.summary: A35 declares a global optimization target and A357/A358 govern Python->native promotion budgets, but no provision declares the per-module optimization direction or the primary metrics each module must report; optimization work is therefore unevidenced and unverifiable per module.

rows.subject: per-module-optimization-direction-and-metric-matrix
rows.rule: PER-MODULE-OPTIMIZATION-MATRIX:each module owns an explicit optimization direction and its primary observation metrics; C-RUNTIME>release-optimization+cross-module-optimization(LTO) metrics=cpu+ram+p95; CPP-INFERENCE>compiler-optimization+SIMD-paths metrics=tokens/s+latency+ram; RUST-VECTOR-ENGINE>cargo-release+lto metrics=recall@k+query-latency+ram; GO-SEARCH>escape-analysis+gc-tuning+concurrency-control metrics=cpu+ram+search-latency; CSHARP-FSHARP>dotnet-release+applicable-aot/readytorun metrics=startup+gc+ram; JULIA>type-stability+reduced-first-compile metrics=compute-time+startup-time; JAX>jit+reduced-recompilation metrics=training-throughput+gpu-vram; JAVASCRIPT-REACT>existing-build-optimization+reduced-duplicate-render metrics=ui-cpu+memory. EVIDENCE:every optimization change records before/after primary metrics for its module on the governed host profile; numeric-altering flags (e.g. fast-math) count as semantic changes, not optimizations, and require parity evidence.
rows.prohibition: FORBID:optimization without a declared metric|fast-math or semantics-changing flags presented as pure optimization|release-flag regression without recorded before/after evidence|debug-build shipped as production artifact
rows.exception: debug/diagnostic builds exempt from release-optimization requirement; modules without a declared optimization direction may not claim optimization evidence

verification.expected_audit_result: A626 inserted as the sole per-module optimization matrix; position 625->626 ordering preserved; projections rebuilt for successor generation
